title: 第21章 秦般若第22章 玩火自焚
content_zh:
;;
周尘眼中闪过一丝讶异。
天阳郡城，正是天阳郡的郡府所在，也是整个天阳郡的中心。
那里繁华鼎盛，强者如云，和天风城这种小城根本无法相比。
秦般若双臂环抱，漫不经心道：
“喂，小子，青辞姐姐在郡城那边替你说话，想推荐你代表摘星楼去参加天阳郡炼丹大会。”
她嗤笑一声，继续说道：
“哼，我可告诉你，炼丹大会的名额是有限的。”
“郡城摘星楼的几位炼丹大师，听到这个消息后很不高兴，一个乡下小城的无名之辈，也想挤占名额？你可不一定真能去成。”
周尘微微皱眉，正要说话，方青辞连忙上前一步：“般若，别说了。”
她转身看向周尘，解释道：
“周公子，秦姑娘性子直爽，并无恶意。其实，她是我请来帮忙的。”
“帮忙？”周尘看向方青辞，有些不解，“帮什么忙？”
方青辞解释道：“实不相瞒，周公子，我与般若一样，来自天阳郡城方家，只是最近这几天，才来天风城。”
周尘恍然，怪不得自己在天风城生活了十六年，却从未听说过摘星楼有方青辞这么一位人物，原来她是近期才从郡城调派而来。
方青辞继续道：“我之所以来这天风城，是为了提升我的四品青木血脉。”
“天风城外的落霞山脉深处，生长着一株极为罕见的千年蕴神古树。我需要摄取其中的木魄灵韵，借此激发血脉潜能。”
“但这蕴神古树非同寻常，其木质坚逾精铁，寻常刀剑难伤，水火不侵。
“只有特殊的异火持续煅烧，才能勉强炼化其表，汲取内蕴的灵韵。”
说到这里，她看向身旁的秦般若：

“而般若妹妹，身怀四品赤焱朱雀血脉，天生伴生一种威力极强的南明离火，十方克制蕴神古树。”
“我请她前来，就是为了帮我对付蕴神古树。”
秦般若听到方青辞夸赞她的火焰，得意一笑，瞥了周尘一眼：
“现在知道本小姐的厉害了吧？”
周尘恍然。
他眉头微挑，道：“方小姐，这蕴神古树和木魄灵韵固然珍贵，秦姑娘的南明离火也确实厉害。”
“但，这与我有什么关系呢？”
方青辞微微一笑，解释道：“周公子有所不知。那木魄灵韵性极寒冽，能量磅礴且带有极强的木系侵蚀特性。”
“在汲取炼化之前，我必须先服用一枚特殊的护脉丹药，三品青木护脉丹。”
“此丹能在我经脉中形成一层特殊的保护膜，可以抵御木魄灵韵的寒冽冲击，还能中和其狂暴的木系侵蚀之力，确保炼化过程万无一失。”
她顿了顿，继续说道：
“而这青木护脉丹，炼制手法极为特殊，对丹火要求极高，一般炼丹师的丹火难以满足。”
“只有以异火为源，方有可能成功。”
方青辞看向周尘和秦般若两人，眸光流转：
“所以，我才需要二位的帮助。”
秦般若接过话头：“喂小子，青辞说你的控火本事和炼丹术是顶尖的，所以，我的异火，加上你的技术，我们俩合作，才能把这青木护脉丹炼出来。懂了么？”
周尘闻言，这才彻底明白过来。
原来是要他与这位脾气火爆，身怀异火的大小姐合作炼丹。
方青辞见周尘答应，脸上露出欣喜之色：
“太好了！丹方和所需药材我已备齐，就在楼上的炼丹室内。”

“事不宜迟，我们这就开始吧？”
周尘点头：“可。”
秦般若也扬起下巴：“带路吧，早点炼完，本小姐还要回去修炼呢。”

A trace of surprise flashed in Zhou Chen's eyes.
Tianyang County City is the seat of Tianyang County and the center of the entire Tianyang County.
The place was prosperous and prosperous, with powerful people like clouds. It was incomparable to a small city like Tianfeng City.
Qin Banruo crossed his arms and said casually:
"Hey, kid, Sister Qingci is speaking for you over there in the county and would like to recommend you to represent the Zhaixinglou to participate in the Tianyang County Alchemy Conference."
She sneered and continued:
"Huh, let me tell you, the number of places in the Alchemy Conference is limited."
"Several alchemy masters at the Star Reaching Tower in the county were very unhappy after hearing the news. An unknown person from a small rural town also wants to squeeze in the quota? You may not really be able to do it."
Zhou Chen frowned slightly and was about to speak when Fang Qingci quickly stepped forward and said, "Prajna, stop talking."
She turned to look at Zhou Chen and explained:
"Mr. Zhou, Miss Qin is straightforward and has no ill intentions. In fact, I invited her to help."
"Help?" Zhou Chen looked at Fang Qingci, a little confused, "What help?"
Fang Qingci explained: "To be honest, Mr. Zhou, like Prajna, I come from the Fang family in Tianyang County. I only came to Tianfeng City in the past few days."
Zhou Chen suddenly realized that no wonder he had lived in Tianfeng City for sixteen years, but he had never heard of a person like Fang Qingci in Zhaixing Tower. It turned out that she had just been transferred from the county town recently.
Fang Qingci continued: "The reason why I came to Tianfeng City is to improve my fourth-grade Aoki bloodline."
"In the depths of the Luoxia Mountains outside Tianfeng City, there is an extremely rare thousand-year-old Yunshen ancient tree growing. I need to absorb the aura of wood soul in it to stimulate the potential of my bloodline."
"But the Yunshen Ancient Tree is extraordinary. Its wood is stronger than fine iron. It is difficult to be damaged by ordinary swords and is invulnerable to water and fire.
“Only by continuing to calcine the special strange fire, can it barely refine its surface and absorb the inner aura. "
Having said this, she looked at Qin Banruo beside her:
"As for Sister Prajna, she possesses the bloodline of the fourth-grade Red Flame Suzaku, and is born with an extremely powerful Nanming Lihuo, which can restrain the Yunshen Ancient Tree from all directions. "
"I asked her to come here just to help me deal with the Yunshen Ancient Tree. "
When Qin Banruo heard Fang Qingci praising her flames, he smiled proudly and glanced at Zhou Chen:
"Now you know how powerful this lady is, right? "
Zhou Chen suddenly realized.
He raised his brows slightly and said: "Miss Fang, the Yunshen Ancient Tree and the Wood Soul Spiritual Charm are certainly precious, and Miss Qin's Nanming Lihuo is also really powerful. "
"But what does this have to do with me? "
Fang Qingci smiled slightly and explained: "Master Zhou doesn't know something. The aura of the wood spirit is extremely cold, the energy is majestic, and it has extremely strong wood erosion properties. "
"Before absorbing and refining, I must first take a special pulse-protecting pill, the third-grade Aoki Pulse-Protecting Pill. "
"This elixir can form a special protective film in my meridians, which can withstand the cold impact of the wood soul aura, and can also neutralize its violent wood element corrosive power, ensuring that the refining process is foolproof. "
She paused and continued:
“The refining technique of this Qingmu Pulse Protecting Pill is extremely special, and it requires extremely high levels of alchemy fire, which is difficult to meet with the alchemy fire of ordinary alchemists. "
“Only by using strange fire as the source can we possibly succeed. "
Fang Qingci looked at Zhou Chen and Qin Banruo, his eyes flowing:
"That's why I need your help. "
Qin Banruo took over the conversation: "Hey kid, Qing Ci said that your fire control ability and alchemy skills are top-notch, so with my strange fire and your skills, we can work together to refine this Qingmu Pulse Protection Pill. Got it? "
After Zhou Chen heard this, he finally understood.
It turned out that he was asked to cooperate with this young lady with a hot temper and a strange fire to make alchemy.
When Fang Qingci saw Zhou Chen agreeing, his face showed joy:
"Great! I have prepared the elixir recipe and the required medicinal materials, which are in the alchemy room upstairs. "
"Without further ado, let's get startedBar? "
Zhou Chen nodded: "Yes. "
Qin Banruo also raised his chin: "Lead the way, finish practicing as soon as possible, I have to go back to practice. "
